# Northwind Labs: client brief

## Client and what is in scope

- Brand: Northwind Cloud only (contract.md §1). Edge and Academy are excluded (contract.md §4).
- Channels: paid search and LinkedIn (contract.md §2).
- Term and fees: 6 months, monthly retainer (contract.md §5).

## Goal

25 enterprise sales-qualified opportunities per quarter (sales-call-transcript.md 00:04:10).

## Mismatches

1. Call vs contract: the call discusses three products (Cloud, Edge, Academy); the contract covers Cloud only and excludes the others. Edge already has live spend (campaign-export.csv rows 7 to 8).
2. Proposal vs contract: the proposal recommends a landing page refresh (proposal.md §3); the contract excludes landing page work (contract.md §4).
3. Goal vs setup: the goal is enterprise opportunities, but every campaign optimizes for any form submission (campaign-export.csv column 4).

## Open questions

1. [blocking] Who is the approver? No approver is named; the CEO may also want sign-off (sales-call-transcript.md 00:21:30). Owner: client.
2. [blocking] LinkedIn access is pending. The contract's access deadline (5 business days after 2026-09-22) has already passed. Owner: client.
3. What happens to the live Edge spend the contract excludes? Owner: account lead.
